mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.MntrgReprtsMapper.selectCombo1List : 통합기관 LIST */ AA.INST_NO AS INST_NO , AA.INST_NM AS INST_NM , AA.INST_TYPE_SE_CD AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD FROM SAA000 AA /* 통합기관 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN != 'Y'

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{instNo} AS INST_NO , #{startDate} AS START_DATE , #{endDate} AS END_DATE FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.MntrgReprtsMapper.selectMntrgReprtsList : 모니터링보고서목록 LIST */ AA.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM , AA.CRT_YMD , AA.MNTRNG_NO FROM AYC400 AA /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 */ , SAA200 BB /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 CC /* 종사자 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.CRT_YMD BETWEEN ZZ.START_DATE AND ZZ.END_DATE
AND BB.USER_ID = AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AND BB.INST_NO = ZZ.INST_NO AND CC.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO
ORDER BY 2 DESC , 1

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{MNTRNG_NO} AS MNTRNG_NO FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.MntrgReprtsMapper.selectMntrgReprtsDetail : 모니터링보고서상세 */ BB.JOB_BGNG_TM || ' ~ ' || AA.JOB_END_TM AS JOB_TM , BB.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM /* 업무보고상담사명 */ , BB.SECRE_NTABRD_NOCS /* 비밀게시판건수 */ , BB.NEXT_NTABRD_NOCS /* 다음게시판건수 */ , BB.NTABRD_NAVER_NOCS /* 게시판네이버건수 */ , BB.JAM_PSTG_NOCS /* JAM게시건수 */ , BB.CHTT_NOCS /* 채팅건수 */ , BB.CMNT_NOCS /* 댓글건수 */ , BB.SLRBT_CMNT_NOCS || ' / ' || BB.NTABRD_SLRBT_PRFMNC_NOCS /* 솔로봇댓글건수 / 게시판솔로봇실적건수 */ , BB.CHTT_OPEN_TM /* 채팅오픈시각 */ , CC.LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ , BB.CHTT_END_TM /* 채팅종료시각 */ , BB.CHTT_UNESTA_TM /* 채팅미개설시각 */ , '' AS REST_TM /* 상담자휴게시간 */ FROM AYC400 AA /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 */ , AYC410 BB /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYC420 CC /* 사이버상담사퇴근관리(모니터링) */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.MNTRNG_NO = ZZ.MNTRNG_NO AND BB.MNTRNG_NO = AA.MNTRNG_NO AND CC.MNTRNG_NO = ZZ.MNTRNG_NO
